sav.title: Compare savings options
sav.subtitle: Savings-account and Fixed Deposit rates from different banks, kept up to date by your campus administrator.
sav.disclaimer: Rates change often — this is reference information only, not live or official. Always confirm with the bank.
sav.intro: A reading table, not a shortlist. Every figure below is what a bank published, typed in by an administrator — the fastest way to tell the numbers apart, and never a recommendation to open an account.
sav.asOf: Figures as of {date}. This is a snapshot taken by hand, not a live feed.
sav.printNote: Printing or saving this page keeps the disclaimer above and the as-of date with the table.
sav.summaryNote: “Best” only ever means the highest figure published for that product type. It is not a recommendation, and it does not account for fees, access or your own situation.
sav.caption: Published savings and Fixed Deposit rates, with the date the table was last updated
sav.emptyBody: The table is empty because no administrator has entered any rates. Once they do, every rate shows up here with its minimum, tenure and the source it was read from.
sav.noMatchBody: Try a different product type, or clear the bank search to see everything on the list.
sav.whatIsFd: A savings account pays interest on the balance you keep, and you can usually take it out whenever you like. A Fixed Deposit (FD) locks a sum away for a fixed number of months at a rate agreed in advance — in return for the bank knowing the money is not coming back before the term ends. That is the whole difference: flexibility against a rate that is locked in for a while.
sav.minimumNote: Minimums are shown exactly as the bank publishes them, in that bank's own currency, so the figures across banks are not always in the same money.
sav.bankIsTruth: The bank is the only source of truth here. A rate on this page can be out of date, withdrawn, or limited to a branch or a new customer — the only way to know is to ask the bank yourself, in person or on its website.
sav.admin.title: Savings options
sav.admin.subtitle: Publish and retire the savings and Fixed Deposit rates students read on the compare page.
sav.admin.disclaimerReminder: Anything you add here is read by students as reference. Publish the figure exactly as the bank states it, and say where you read it.
sav.admin.emptyBody: Add the first rate and it appears on the compare page straight away. One row per product per bank.
sav.admin.bankHelp: The bank's name as students will recognise it.
sav.admin.rateHelp: The annual rate as printed, with no % sign — for example 11.5. Up to two decimals, between 0 and 100.
sav.admin.minimumHelp: The smallest deposit the bank asks for, if it publishes one. Leave empty when there is none.
sav.admin.tenureHelp: How many months the money is locked away. Fixed Deposits only — leave empty for a savings account.
sav.admin.noteHelp: Anything a student needs in order to read the rate correctly, such as a new-customer condition.
sav.admin.sourceHelp: Where you read the figure, and roughly when. This is what makes a rate checkable instead of a rumour.
sav.admin.retiredBadge: Retired — not on the compare page
sav.admin.created: Rate published — it is on the compare page now.
sav.admin.retired: Rate retired — students no longer see it.
sav.admin.removeBody: “{bank}” at {rate} leaves the table for good.
sav.admin.removeRetire: To take it off the page without losing the record, use Retire instead.
